confirmed_source_facts: The presentation compiler classifies the Level Start Panel as static. Its level-start runtime and deferred layer lists are empty (scripts/build_presentation.py:184-209). The phase overlay only clears cells at y=9, y=4, and y=20; it does not replace the candidate collectible row at y=17-18 (scripts/build_presentation.py:888-910).

The authored level-start TMX contains three repeated two-by-two marker patterns at x=17-18, 19-20, and 21-22 over y=17-18. Each pattern has GIDs (264,228;486,468), so the three preview icons are identical in source; no type-specific variant is encoded in these cells.

The shared stage-panel runtime writes part, bonus value/name, GOOD LUCK, and the vegetable sprite. No letter-type selection or letter-to-preview drawing is present (src/shared_text_stage.inc:482-497, 547-696).

Gameplay selects one random letter from X/T/R, one from S/P/C/I/L, and one from E/A, then stores the chosen object variants in ENTITY_TABLE (src/main.s:1745-1834). These are the only source references to letter_xtr/letter_spcil/letter_ea.

For first credited start, the presentation screen is loaded before live_begin calls init_gameplay and init_entities (src/presentation_runtime.s:379-455, 801-874; src/main.s:1038). For subsequent stage, next_stage calls init_entities before loading level-start (src/presentation_runtime.s:365-377; src/main.s:1022-1038). The NEXT_STAGE release path exits level mode without another init_gameplay, so source shows one letter selection per stage, not a second random selection at release (src/presentation_runtime.s:801-813).

diagnosis.leading_cause: Static authored marker icons on the level-start panel are not connected to the randomized entity variants. The preview has no dynamic letter producer; maze gameplay has a single randomized producer.
diagnosis.rng_reselection: Not supported by the inspected source. Subsequent-stage init runs before preview and is retained at release; first-start init runs once after preview.
diagnosis.translation_or_handoff: No letter preview translation path exists to fail. The phase ordering creates a first-start visibility gap, but no repeated letter selection is found.
diagnosis.evidence_limit: No reproduction capture or stable current artifact/live-memory comparison is included in this source-only receipt. The exact pixel identity of the user's reported preview slots remains to be confirmed on the stable final build.

proposed_outcome_only: Make the preview display the exact three selected letter types that init_entities places for that stage, with selection consumed once and the selected values reused. Preserve letter groups/probabilities, object-placement call order/distribution, rewards, and replacement-life behavior.
provisional_cost_class: High-risk: the first-stage screen precedes gameplay entity creation, while later-stage entity creation precedes that same screen. Bridging the value across the presentation/gameplay phase boundary changes runtime ownership or initialization order.
